name: Divine Nordic Relic Mjolnir
effect:
You can only equip this card to an “Aesir” monster.
The equipped monster gains 1000 ATK/DEF.
If this card is equipped to “Thor, Lord of Aesir” or “Thor, God of Thunder”: You can send this card to the GY; target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it, then if it was a monster, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original ATK.
